tw-mn-warsaw-murphy-crock-1920.t: Search first around James's own house site (1900 plat: SE quarter of sec. 23 by the sec. 23/24 line, where a farmstead still stands today), then the old barnyard edge. Frank's 1915 yard on the sec. 24 side is plowed field now.
src: James Murphy obituary (May 1901) and estate tax record; Mankato 1920 wire story (deep-dive notes, research/treasure-statewide/deep-dives/)

tw-mn-sigel-kuehn-plum-trees-1906.st: Later reading: the jar of notes and certificates was very likely the buried papers, and the will contest was settled in May 1906, so the odds that more money remains are modest. A farm building group still stands in the NW part of the SW quarter of sec. 22 by the sec. 21/22 road (about 44.2305,-94.5517).

pinev: Parcel centroid of 653 W 3rd St (Chutes Addition Lot 14 Block 11), about 700 m from the earlier street-grid guess; the house-number match to 1933 is not yet checked against a Sanborn map.

tw-mn-winona-schmidt-crocks-1933.st: The pin now sits on the 653 W 3rd St lot (Chutes Addition Lot 14, Block 11); the match of that house number to 1933 is not yet checked.
